name: Ablonite-KR
description: A reactive armor ceramic engineered with a graded porosity microstructure that undergoes controlled ablative fracture under ballistic impact, dissipating kinetic energy through a cascade of microcrack propagation and vaporization of sacrificial material layers. Each impact consumes a calculated thickness of Ablonite-KR, but the underlying substrate remains intact, and the ablated surface can be field-repaired with a compatible ceramic slurry injector. Crucible Industries developed the formulation in partnership with military contractors seeking an alternative to monolithic plate armor.
story_hooks: A shipment of Ablonite-KR panels has been rerouted to a Tier 1 insurgent group — Crucible Industries wants the material recovered before its composition can be reverse-engineered.
The field-repair slurry for Ablonite-KR has been adulterated with a tracking compound; every soldier who patches their armor is now broadcasting their location.

A demolitions expert realizes that the ablative cascade in Ablonite-KR can be triggered simultaneously across a large panel using a specific ultrasonic frequency — turning armor plating into a fragmentation weapon.
